# rms_permissions (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of all available Teltonika RMS permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_permissions" "all" {}

output "permission_names" {
  value = [for p in data.rms_permissions.all.permissions : p.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier for this data source.
- `permissions` (Attributes List) List of available permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Permission description.
- `id` (Number) Permission ID, as accepted by rms_role.permission_ids. Null if the API does not report one.
- `name` (String) Permission name/identifier.
